published_title: WTF Lightside Manip deck based on MF s Article
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Iceman''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in December 1999.
description: This is a deck based on my article ' Manipulation Means for the Lightside'.It is a decent deck. Weird and interesting. It's pretty nasty too. Something to ponder in the closing days of Pre-ECC.
cards: posted: Errata - The extra Yargna and AFAggression should be Landing Claws.
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: TITLE WITHHELD: the published title begins with 'WTF'.

Total 60 as published, after the author's correction (below); the 'Start (3)' section (Obi-Wan's Hut, Careful Planning, Beggar's Canyon) counts toward the 60. No Objective, so the starting site Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut is starting.card and Careful Planning starting.interrupt.

Author's correction applied: the post says 'The extra Yargna and AFAggression should be Landing Claws', so Yargna x2 became 1 Yarna d'al' Gargan, Anger, Fear, Aggression (x1) was dropped and 2 Landing Claw added (the strategy also says 'Claw in space').
Posted 'Leaders x2' (under Starships) can't be matched with confidence (Gold Leader In Gold 1 / Red Leader In Red 1?): UNKNOWN, shown as posted.

Elom x13 as posted (Elom is not unique). 'NTMTOdds' dested Never Tell Me The Odds; 'Revo' Revolution; 'Yargna' the Effect Yarna d'al' Gargan; 'Nar Shaddaa' Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes; 'Signal' The Signal; 'TTerminated' Transmission Terminated.
